templates.subject: Checking in
templates.body_text:
Hope your week is going well. Just wanted to check in and see where things stand on your end.

Let me know whenever you get a chance.

templates.subject: Quick check-in
templates.body_text: Haven't heard back so I wanted to make sure my last message didn't get buried. No rush at all — just want to make sure we're on the same page.

templates.subject: How's it going on your end?
templates.body_text: Just wanted to see how things are coming along. Let me know if there's anything you need from me in the meantime.

templates.subject: Circling back
templates.body_text: Just circling back on this — I know things get busy. Whenever you have a minute, I'd love to hear where you're at.

templates.subject: Still on your radar?
templates.body_text: I know you've got a lot on your plate, so no pressure. Just wanted to make sure this didn't fall off your radar entirely.

templates.subject: Any updates on your end?
templates.body_text: Hope things have been good. I was curious if there were any updates on your end — even just a quick status would be helpful.
templates.signature: Thanks for the heads up either way

templates.subject: Touching base
templates.body_text: Touching base before the week gets away from us. Let me know how things are looking on your end and if there's anything I should be aware of.

templates.subject: Just wanted to check in
templates.body_text: I've been meaning to reach out. How are things going? Anything I can do to help move things along on my side?

templates.subject: Following up from earlier
templates.body_text: Just following up on the conversation we had earlier. I want to make sure I didn't miss anything on my end before things move forward.

templates.subject: Re: our conversation
templates.body_text: I've been thinking about what we discussed and wanted to follow up while it was still fresh. Let me know if you have a few minutes to connect.

templates.subject: One thing I forgot to mention
templates.body_text: I should have brought this up when we talked, but it slipped my mind. Figured I'd send it over now before it got lost in the shuffle.

templates.subject: Quick follow-up
templates.body_text: I wanted to follow up quickly since I know the timeline on this is a bit tight. Let me know what works on your end.

templates.subject: From our call last week
templates.body_text: Following up from our call last week — I tracked down what you were asking about. Let me know if this is what you needed.

templates.subject: Still thinking about what you said
templates.body_text: I've been mulling over what you mentioned and wanted to come back to it. I think there might be more to dig into here.
templates.signature: Let me know when you're free

templates.subject: Wanted to get back to you sooner
templates.body_text: Sorry for the delay — this ended up taking longer than expected on my end. I have what you need now though.

templates.subject: Getting back to you
templates.body_text: I promised I'd get back to you and I'm a little late doing it. Here's where things stand from my end.

templates.subject: Coffee this week?
templates.body_text: Are you free to grab coffee at some point this week? I'd love to catch up and there's something I wanted to run by you.

templates.subject: Lunch Thursday?
templates.body_text: Any chance you're free for lunch Thursday? Figured it'd be a good excuse to catch up — it's been a while.

templates.subject: Can we find 30 minutes?
templates.body_text: I've got something I'd like to walk you through — nothing complicated, just easier to show than explain over email. Do you have 30 minutes this week or next?

templates.subject: Quick call?
templates.body_text: Would you be open to a quick call sometime today or tomorrow? I have a few things I want to run by you and it'd be faster than going back and forth over email.

templates.subject: Do you have time this week?
templates.body_text: I know you're busy but I wanted to see if you had any pockets of time this week. Even 20 minutes would be plenty.

templates.subject: When works for you?
templates.body_text: I want to set up some time to connect. What does your schedule look like over the next week or so? I'm pretty flexible.

templates.subject: Let's find a time
templates.body_text: We keep meaning to connect and it keeps getting pushed. Let's just put something on the calendar — what days work best for you?

templates.subject: Can we move our meeting?
templates.body_text: Something came up on my end and I need to move our meeting. Would you be open to shifting it by a day or two? Sorry for the inconvenience.

templates.subject: Still on for tomorrow?
templates.body_text: Just wanted to confirm we're still on for tomorrow. Let me know if anything has changed on your end and I'll adjust.

templates.subject: Happy to work around your schedule
templates.body_text: I know mornings can be hectic. I'm happy to work around whatever schedule makes most sense for you — just let me know.

templates.subject: Quick question
templates.body_text: I have a question that came up and I figured you'd be the right person to ask. It shouldn't take long — do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Had a question for you
templates.body_text: I was thinking about something and realized I don't have a clear answer. Do you happen to know off the top of your head?

templates.subject: One quick thing
templates.body_text: This might be a dumb question but I'd rather ask than guess wrong. What's your take on this?

templates.subject: Can I ask you something?
templates.body_text: I wanted to pick your brain on something. It's not urgent, but when you have a few minutes I'd love to hear your perspective.

templates.subject: Curious what you think
templates.body_text: I've been going back and forth on something and I'd value your input. What's your gut reaction to this?

templates.subject: Something I've been wondering about
templates.body_text: I've had this question sitting in the back of my mind for a while and finally decided to just send it. Do you have thoughts on this?

templates.subject: Not sure who else to ask
templates.body_text: You're the most likely person to have dealt with this before. Any chance you have a minute to walk me through it?

templates.subject: You'd probably know this
templates.body_text: I thought of you right away when this question came up. It's right up your alley — do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Trying to figure something out
templates.body_text: I've been trying to figure something out and I'm going in circles a little. Do you have experience with this kind of thing?

templates.subject: Quick one
templates.body_text: Quick one — do you know offhand or would I need to look this up somewhere else?

templates.subject: Small favor
templates.body_text: I have a small favor to ask — nothing major. Let me know if you have a couple of minutes and I'll explain.

templates.subject: Could you help me out?
templates.body_text: I could use a hand with something that's a little outside my wheelhouse. I think it'd be quick for someone with your background.

templates.subject: Can I ask a favor?
templates.body_text: I know you're busy so feel free to say no, but I wanted to ask. Would you be able to help me out with something this week?

templates.subject: Need your input on something
templates.body_text: I've been working through something and could really use your input. Your perspective on this would be valuable — do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Any chance you could help with this?
templates.body_text: I wouldn't ask if I could figure it out on my own, but I think you'd know exactly what to do here. Any chance you have time to take a look?

templates.subject: Would you be able to take a look?
templates.body_text: I put something together and I'd feel better getting a second set of eyes on it before I move forward. Would you be willing to take a look?

templates.subject: Can you review this before I send it?
templates.body_text: Before I pull the trigger on this, I want to make sure I'm not missing anything obvious. Would you mind taking a quick look?

templates.subject: Mind taking a look?
templates.body_text: I don't want to send this out without having someone else read it first. Would you mind taking a quick look and letting me know if anything seems off?

templates.subject: Would love your feedback
templates.body_text: I've been working on something and I'd genuinely love your feedback. You tend to notice things I miss.
templates.signature: Let me know your honest thoughts

templates.subject: Can you help me think through this?
templates.body_text: I'm trying to work through something and I think talking it out would help more than staring at it alone. Do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Heads up
templates.body_text: Just wanted to give you a quick heads up before this makes its way to you through other channels. Nothing to worry about, just wanted you to have the context.

templates.subject: FYI
templates.body_text: Passing this along in case it's useful. No action needed on your end — just thought you'd want to know.

templates.subject: Just so you know
templates.body_text: Wanted to loop you in on something before it came as a surprise. Just so you have the full picture.
templates.signature: Let me know if you have questions

templates.subject: Thought you'd want to see this
templates.body_text: I came across something and thought of you immediately. Figured I'd pass it along — might be relevant to what you're working on.
templates.signature: Let me know what you think

templates.subject: Keeping you in the loop
templates.body_text: I wanted to keep you in the loop on this. Nothing you need to act on right now — just didn't want it to catch you off guard later.

templates.subject: Something you might find useful
templates.body_text: I ran into this and thought it might be relevant to something you've been working on. Take it or leave it — just thought it was worth passing along.

templates.subject: Worth knowing
templates.body_text: Not sure if you're already aware of this, but I figured it was better to mention it than assume you knew.

templates.subject: Just a quick note
templates.body_text: I wanted to drop a quick note before things got too hectic. Nothing pressing — just thought this was worth mentioning.

templates.subject: Passing this along
templates.body_text: Someone shared this with me and I immediately thought of you. Not sure if it's directly useful but it seemed worth sending over.

templates.subject: Quick note
templates.body_text: Just a quick note — I don't want to make this a bigger deal than it is, but I thought it was worth mentioning in case it affects anything on your end.

templates.subject: Good to reconnect
templates.body_text: It's been a while! I was thinking about our last conversation and figured it was time to reconnect. How have things been on your end?

templates.subject: Long time no talk
templates.body_text: I know it's been a while since we've been in touch. I've been meaning to reach out and kept putting it off — figured now was as good a time as any.

templates.subject: Been meaning to reach out
templates.body_text: I've had your name on my mental to-do list for a while now. Glad I finally got around to sending this. Would love to catch up when you have time.

templates.subject: Reaching out
templates.body_text: I hope this finds you well. I wanted to reach out because I think there might be a good opportunity for us to connect. Let me know if you'd be open to a quick chat.
templates.signature: Looking forward to hearing from you

templates.subject: Thought I'd say hi
templates.body_text: I thought I'd drop a note and say hi. It's been too long and I feel bad about letting so much time pass without being in touch.

templates.subject: Thank you
templates.body_text: I just wanted to say thank you. It meant a lot that you took the time to help, and I didn't want it to go unacknowledged.

templates.subject: Really appreciate your help
templates.body_text: I wanted to reach out and say how much I appreciated your help with this. It made a real difference and I'm grateful.

templates.subject: That was really helpful
templates.body_text: I just wanted to let you know that was genuinely helpful. I feel a lot better about where things stand now. Thank you for making the time.

templates.subject: Thanks for yesterday
templates.body_text: Thanks for making time yesterday — I know your schedule is packed. The conversation was exactly what I needed.

templates.subject: Wanted to say thanks
templates.body_text: I know I probably don't say this enough, but I really do appreciate everything you do. This was particularly helpful.

templates.subject: You saved me a lot of time
templates.body_text: Seriously — you saved me a lot of time on this one. I would have been spinning my wheels for hours without your help.

templates.subject: That went well, thanks to you
templates.body_text: I just wanted to let you know it went well. I don't think it would have without your help in the lead-up. Really appreciate it.

templates.subject: Thank you for being patient
templates.body_text: I know I've been a bit scattered lately and you've been patient with me. I just wanted to acknowledge that and say thank you.

templates.subject: Sorry for the delay
templates.body_text: I'm sorry for taking so long to get back to you. Things got hectic and this fell further down the list than it should have.

templates.subject: My apologies
templates.body_text: I owe you an apology. I dropped the ball on this one and I want to make sure it doesn't happen again.

templates.subject: Sorry about that
templates.body_text: That was on me and I'm sorry. I should have handled it differently and I appreciate your patience in the meantime.

templates.subject: I should have gotten back to you sooner
templates.body_text: I know I should have responded sooner — I don't have a great excuse. I just wanted to acknowledge it and make sure we're good.

templates.subject: Apologies for the confusion
templates.body_text: I think I may have caused some confusion with my last message and I wanted to clear it up. That wasn't my intention at all.

templates.subject: Got your message
templates.body_text: Got your message — sorry for the slow reply. Things have been a bit hectic on my end. I'll have more to share once I have a chance to look into it properly.

templates.subject: Re: your note
templates.body_text: Thanks for sending this over. I've had a chance to read through it and I have a few thoughts I'd like to share when we next connect.

templates.subject: Saw your message
templates.body_text: I saw your message and wanted to get back to you quickly. I think I have what you're looking for — let me pull it together.

templates.subject: Good point
templates.body_text: That's actually a really good point and I hadn't thought about it that way. Let me sit with it for a bit and I'll get back to you with my thoughts.

templates.subject: That makes sense
templates.body_text: That makes a lot more sense now that you've explained it. I think I was overcomplicating it on my end. Let's go with what you suggested.

templates.subject: Noted — I'll look into it
templates.body_text: Thanks for flagging that. I'll look into it on my end and get back to you with what I find. Shouldn't take long.

templates.subject: Good to hear from you
templates.body_text: Good to hear from you! I'll take a look at what you sent and follow up shortly. Thanks for sending it over.

templates.subject: Thanks for the update
templates.body_text: Thanks for keeping me in the loop. I'll review what you sent and let you know if I have any questions.

templates.subject: Just making sure we're aligned
templates.body_text: Before we go too far down this road, I just want to make sure we're aligned on a few things. Can we find a few minutes to sync up?

templates.subject: Who's handling this?
templates.body_text: I want to make sure we're not duplicating effort here. Do you know who's taking the lead on this? Happy to coordinate however makes the most sense.

templates.subject: Can we get everyone on the same page?
templates.body_text: I feel like there are a few moving pieces here and not everyone has the same picture. Is now a good time to get everyone aligned?

templates.subject: Dividing up the work
templates.body_text: I want to make sure we're splitting things up in a way that makes sense. Can we spend a few minutes mapping out who's doing what?

templates.subject: Making sure nothing falls through the cracks
templates.body_text: I just want to make sure nothing falls through the cracks on this. Can you let me know what's on your end and I'll do the same?

templates.subject: Quick sync?
templates.body_text: I think a quick sync would help us both move faster. It shouldn't take more than 15 minutes. Does that work for you?

templates.subject: Can we walk through this together?
templates.body_text: I'd feel a lot better walking through this together before we commit to anything. Are you free sometime this week?

templates.subject: Thinking through the next steps
templates.body_text: I've been thinking through the next steps here and I want to make sure my thinking lines up with yours before I move forward.

templates.subject: Let's get ahead of this
templates.body_text: I'd rather get ahead of this now than deal with it later. Can we carve out some time this week to talk through where things stand?

templates.subject: Just want to make sure I have the right info
templates.body_text: Before I go any further, I want to make sure I have the right information. Can you confirm a couple of things for me?

templates.subject: How's everything going?
templates.body_text: I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out. How's everything going? I hope things have been good on your end.

templates.subject: Hope you're doing well
templates.body_text: Just wanted to send a quick note and hope you're doing well. It's been a while and I miss catching up.

templates.subject: How's the family?
templates.body_text: How's the family doing? It's been a while since we've had a chance to really catch up. Would love to hear what's going on with everyone.

templates.subject: Thinking of you
templates.body_text: I was thinking of you today and figured I'd send a quick note. Hope things are going well on your end. Let's find a time to catch up soon.

templates.subject: Heard the news — congrats!
templates.body_text: I heard the news and I just wanted to say congratulations! That's really exciting and you deserve it. Let's celebrate when you have a free moment.

templates.subject: Just wanted to check in on you
templates.body_text: I heard things have been a bit rough lately and I just wanted to check in. No need to go into detail — I just want you to know I'm thinking about you.

templates.subject: Miss catching up
templates.body_text: It's been way too long. I miss our conversations — we need to make more of an effort to stay in touch. When are you free?

templates.subject: Friendly reminder
templates.body_text: Just a friendly reminder in case this got buried. No pressure — I just wanted to make sure it didn't slip through the cracks.

templates.subject: Don't forget
templates.body_text: I know you've got a lot going on, so just a quick reminder. Better to catch it early than scramble later.

templates.subject: Quick reminder before the weekend
templates.body_text: Didn't want this to get lost over the weekend. Just a quick reminder before everyone checks out.

templates.subject: Coming up soon
templates.body_text: I just wanted to flag that this is coming up sooner than it probably feels like. Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.

templates.subject: Just a nudge
templates.body_text: I hate to be the person who follows up on their own follow-up, but I wanted to send a gentle nudge. Totally understand if it's not the right time.

templates.subject: Sharing something I found
templates.body_text: I came across something I thought you'd find interesting. No particular reason — it just made me think of you.

templates.subject: You might like this
templates.body_text: I thought of you when I saw this. Not sure if it's directly useful but it seemed worth passing along.
templates.signature: Let me know what you think

templates.subject: Have you seen this?
templates.body_text: Have you come across this yet? I stumbled on it and thought it was worth sharing. Curious what your take is.

templates.subject: This reminded me of our conversation
templates.body_text: I saw this and immediately thought of what we were talking about the other day. Thought you'd appreciate it.

templates.subject: Came across something relevant
templates.body_text: I came across something that might be relevant to what you're working on. Happy to talk through it if it's useful.

templates.subject: One more thing
templates.body_text: I forgot to mention this earlier — figured I'd send it now before it slipped my mind entirely.

templates.subject: Sorry for the short notice
templates.body_text: Apologies for the last-minute message — something came up and I wanted to get ahead of it before it became a bigger problem.

templates.subject: This is a bit out of the blue
templates.body_text: I know this might be coming a little out of nowhere, but I wanted to reach out. I hope it's not a bad time.

templates.subject: I might be wrong about this
templates.body_text: I might be wrong about this so take it with a grain of salt, but I figured it was worth mentioning in case it changes anything.
templates.signature: Let me know what you think

templates.subject: Thought of you
templates.body_text: Something came up that made me think of you right away. I figured you'd either find it interesting or have some thoughts on it.

templates.subject: Worth a quick conversation
templates.body_text: I don't think this is a big deal but I think it's worth a quick conversation before anyone moves forward. Do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: I have an idea
templates.body_text: I had an idea I wanted to run by you before I go any further with it. It might be nothing, but I think there's something there.
templates.signature: Let me know what you think

templates.subject: Can I get your opinion on something?
templates.body_text: I value your opinion and I'd love to hear what you think about something I've been mulling over. It won't take long — promise.

templates.subject: Not sure this is your area but worth asking
templates.body_text: I wasn't sure if this was your area but I figured it was worth asking. If not, do you know who would be the right person?

templates.subject: Can we talk offline?
templates.body_text: I'd rather talk through this offline than try to do it over email. Would you have a few minutes sometime today?

templates.subject: Something to consider
templates.body_text: I've been thinking about something and I think it's worth bringing up. I don't want to overstep but I thought you'd want to know.

templates.subject: Keeping this short
templates.body_text: I'll keep this short — I just wanted to get this to you before the end of the day. We can talk through the details whenever works for you.

templates.subject: While I have your attention
templates.body_text: Since I have your attention — there's something I wanted to mention that I keep forgetting to bring up. This seemed like as good a time as any.

templates.subject: Got a minute?
templates.body_text: Do you have a minute? I have something I want to run by you and it'd be faster to just talk through it.

templates.subject: Might be nothing but worth mentioning
templates.body_text: This might be nothing, but I wanted to mention it just in case. Better to say something now than wish I had later.

templates.subject: Had a thought
templates.body_text: I had a thought and wanted to get it out of my head before I forgot it. Let me know if it's useful or if I'm way off base.

templates.subject: Something I've been putting off
templates.body_text: I've been putting this off for longer than I should have. I finally decided to just send it and see what you think.

templates.subject: Before I forget
templates.body_text: I keep meaning to send this and getting sidetracked. Sending it now before I forget again.

templates.subject: Wanted to give you a heads up
templates.body_text: I just wanted to give you a heads up before you hear it from someone else. It's not a big deal but I wanted you to have the full context.
templates.signature: Let me know if you have questions

templates.subject: You probably already know this
templates.body_text: You probably already know this, but I wanted to mention it just in case. Ignore me if I'm behind the curve here.

templates.subject: Can I borrow your brain for a second?
templates.body_text: Can I borrow your brain for a second? I'm trying to think through something and I think you'd have useful perspective on it.

templates.subject: Something worth revisiting
templates.body_text: I've been thinking about something we touched on a while back and I think it might be worth revisiting. What do you think?

templates.subject: This is probably a long shot
templates.body_text: I know this might be a long shot, but I figured it was worth asking before I go looking elsewhere. Do you happen to know anything about this?

templates.subject: Let me know what you think
templates.body_text: I'd genuinely love to hear your take on this. No right or wrong answer — I'm just trying to get a few different perspectives.

templates.subject: Wanted to loop you in
templates.body_text: I wanted to make sure you were looped in on this. It might end up being relevant to something you're working on.

templates.subject: I think this involves you
templates.body_text: I think this might involve you at some point so I wanted to give you advance notice. Better to know early than be surprised.
templates.signature: Let me know if you want to talk through it

templates.subject: Just need a quick answer
templates.body_text: I just need a quick answer on this — one line is fine. I don't need a big explanation, just enough to know how to proceed.

templates.subject: I'll keep it brief
templates.body_text: I'll keep it brief. I just wanted to flag something before the end of the week in case it changes anything for you.

templates.subject: Ran into a snag
templates.body_text: I ran into a bit of a snag and wanted to flag it early rather than wait until it becomes a bigger issue. Do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Wasn't sure who to ask
templates.body_text: I wasn't sure who the right person to ask was, but I figured you'd either know or know who does. Any help is appreciated.

templates.subject: Slight change of plans
templates.body_text: There's been a slight change of plans on my end. I wanted to let you know as soon as possible so you can adjust if needed.

templates.subject: Just heard back
templates.body_text: I just heard back and wanted to pass the information along while it's fresh. Let me know if you have any questions.

templates.subject: Wasn't expecting this
templates.body_text: I wasn't expecting this to come up but it did, and I wanted to make sure you were aware of it. Let me know how you'd like to handle it.

templates.subject: Just checking something
templates.body_text: I'm just checking something before I commit to anything. Can you confirm this is still accurate on your end?

templates.subject: Something came up
templates.body_text: Something came up that I think we need to talk about. Nothing catastrophic — just better to address it sooner rather than later.
templates.signature: Let me know when you're free

templates.subject: This might be useful for you
templates.body_text: I'm not sure if you need this, but I figured it was better to send it and have you not need it than the other way around.

templates.subject: Making progress
templates.body_text: Just wanted to let you know things are moving along on my end. I'll have something more concrete to share soon.

templates.subject: Almost there
templates.body_text: I'm almost done with my part of this. Just a couple more things to tie up and I'll have it to you by end of day.

templates.subject: Hit a wall
templates.body_text: I've hit a bit of a wall on this and could use a fresh pair of eyes. Would you have a few minutes to talk it through?

templates.subject: Changed my mind
templates.body_text: I thought about it more and I think I was wrong earlier. Let me explain where my head is at now.

templates.subject: Rethinking this
templates.body_text: The more I think about it, the more I think we might want to reconsider the approach here. Would you be open to talking it through?

templates.subject: Are you the right person for this?
templates.body_text: I want to make sure I'm going to the right person with this. Is this your area or should I be talking to someone else?

templates.subject: Any chance you have bandwidth?
templates.body_text: I know you're stretched, so I want to be upfront that this is a genuine ask — not an assumption. Any chance you have bandwidth for one more thing this week?

templates.subject: Just wanted to say
templates.body_text: I just wanted to say something I probably should have said sooner. I hope it comes across the right way over email.

templates.subject: Quick heads up before you hear otherwise
templates.body_text: I wanted to give you a quick heads up before you heard it through the grapevine. I figured you'd rather hear it directly from me.
templates.signature: Let me know if you want to talk

templates.subject: This worked out
templates.body_text: Just wanted to let you know this ended up working out. I'm relieved and I wanted to pass that along.

templates.subject: Didn't go as planned
templates.body_text: Things didn't go quite as planned but I don't think it's a big setback. I'll fill you in when we next talk.

templates.subject: Might need your help on something
templates.body_text: I might need your help on something coming up. Nothing definite yet, but I wanted to give you advance notice in case the timing becomes tight.

templates.subject: Quick update from my end
templates.body_text: Just a quick update from my end — things are moving but there are a couple of things I want to flag before we go further.

templates.subject: Could use a second opinion
templates.body_text: I've been going back and forth on this and I think I need a second opinion before I make a decision. Do you have a few minutes?

templates.subject: Meant to mention this earlier
templates.body_text: I meant to mention this earlier but we ran out of time. I'll keep it brief — just wanted to make sure it got to you.

templates.subject: Last thing — I promise
templates.body_text: Last thing, I promise. I just want to make sure this is on your radar before we wrap up.

templates.subject: I may have spoken too soon
templates.body_text: I may have spoken too soon earlier — things have shifted a bit and I want to make sure you have the updated picture.

templates.subject: Not trying to be pushy
templates.body_text: I want to be clear that I'm not trying to be pushy here — I just want to make sure this doesn't get lost in the shuffle.

templates.subject: Happy to jump on a call
templates.body_text: If it's easier to just talk through this, I'm happy to jump on a call. Sometimes email isn't the best medium for these things.

templates.subject: Don't want to make a big deal of this
templates.body_text: I don't want to make a big deal of this, but I did want to mention it. Take it however you want — no pressure.

templates.subject: Thought we resolved this
templates.body_text: I thought we had resolved this but it seems like it's come back up. Can we take another look at it together?

templates.subject: Just wanted your take
templates.body_text: I'm not looking for a definitive answer here — I just wanted your take on it before I decide anything.

templates.subject: This is time-sensitive
templates.body_text: I hate to do this, but this one is a bit time-sensitive. I wouldn't rush you if it weren't genuinely urgent.

templates.subject: No rush — but when you get a chance
templates.body_text: No rush on this at all. Whenever you get a chance is fine. I just wanted to make sure it was on your radar.
